title: Folded in My Coat
style: Indie-pop, It-pop, young female lead vocal, intimate conversational phrasing with bright youthful tone, gently propulsive midtempo groove, clean chiming electric guitar and rounded bass, crisp restrained drums, small keyboard details; verses stay close and diary-like, pre-chorus gradually opens, chorus lifts into a memorable melodic refrain with soft layered harmonies, bridge turns quieter before the final chorus; polished warm production with clear vocal focus and natural dynamics
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At Villa Jaguar, the table ran long
Christmas leftovers almost made it to Sunday
I said they’d last all week, then laughed
The plates told the truth by Monday

We rode past orchards, through the pasture grass
The farm kept its own steady pace
A swim before the evening cooled
Then I washed my hair and chose my new tunic

[Pre-Chorus]
The day let go in pieces
The house filled up again
I wanted one small moment
Before the year would end

[Chorus]
I keep these days folded in my coat
A little salt, a little smoke from the fireworks
All that I meant to say, I let it go
The year turned over while we watched the dark
And I was there, and I was there

[Verse 2]
At midnight, color rose above the water
A barge lit up the edge of home
Champagne and grapes, the family stayed awake
I watched two figures disappear alone

New Year’s Day moved slowly through the rooms
I let an old suspicion fade
Some people are just who they are
And some things need no name

[Pre-Chorus]
The morning came in softly
No grand reveal, no sign
I set my doubts beside me
And let the day unwind

[Chorus]
I keep these days folded in my coat
A little salt, a little smoke from the fireworks
All that I meant to say, I let it go
The year turned over while we watched the dark
And I was there, and I was there

[Bridge]
Twelve thousand meters over the Atlantic
A sweater warm against the cabin air
Some voices up front, some sleeping
I found a quiet room and stayed there
Barcelona waiting under winter blue
Not my own flat yet, but close enough
One friend beside me, one more day
Before the next goodbye arrives

[Final Chorus]
I keep these days folded in my coat
The farm, the plane, the sea beyond the windows
All that I meant to say, I let it go
The year turned over, and the miles rolled on
I was there, I was there
Barcelona, hold me till the morning
I was there, I was there
